title: Bookkeeper - practice
description:
Bookkeeper

Salary: £30,000 - £35,000 per annum

Location: Langport, Somerset, office based

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent (9am-5:30pm Mon-Thu and 9am-2pm Fri)

A long-established and highly respected accountancy practice based in South Somerset is currently recruiting for a Bookkeeper to join their small team. For over 100 years, the firm has been supporting local businesses, individuals, and entrepreneurs with their accounting, taxation, bookkeeping, and business advisory needs. The practice prides itself on delivering a personal, proactive service and building long-term relationships with clients across a wide range of industries.

The successful candidate will join a friendly and experienced team of accountancy, tax, payroll, and client support professionals, working closely with colleagues to provide exceptional service to a loyal and growing client base.

The Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys building client relationships, working with cloud accounting software, and being part of a supportive and collaborative team environment. You'll become part of a close-knit team that genuinely values client relationships, collaboration, and professional development, whilst enjoying a varied role with responsibility and autonomy from day one

Key Responsibilities
- Maintaining accurate bookkeeping records for a portfolio of clients.
- Processing sales invoices, purchase invoices, receipts, and payments.
- Completing bank reconciliations and investigating discrepancies.
- Preparing and submitting VAT returns.
- Assisting with management accounts preparation.
- Supporting clients with day-to-day accounting queries.
- Working with cloud accounting platforms, including Xero, QuickBooks, and Sage.
- Reviewing bookkeeping records to ensure compliance and accuracy.
- Liaising directly with clients to obtain information and provide support.
- Assisting the wider accounts team with year-end accounting requirements.
- Maintaining strong client relationships and delivering excellent customer service.

Skills & Experience Required
- Previous bookkeeping experience within an accountancy practice or similar environment.
- Good working knowledge of Xero, Sage and/or QuickBooks.
- Experience preparing VAT returns.
- Strong understanding of double-entry bookkeeping principles.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Confident communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Ability to manage multiple deadlines and workloads effectively.
- AAT qualification or equivalent would be advantageous but is not essential.
- Strong IT skills and confidence using cloud-based accounting software.

Salary & Benefits
- £30,000 - £35,000 depending on experience.
- Friendly and supportive team environment.
- Opportunity to work within a well-established and respected local practice, part of a wider group
- Ongoing training and professional development.
- Modern cloud-based systems and technology.
- 22 days holiday + bank hols
- Pension scheme.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Payroll Administrator

Location: Yeovil

Salary: £25,000 - £30,000

Hours: Full-time or Part-time (minimum 30 hours per week)

Working Pattern: Office-based during training, with hybrid working available thereafter

Are you an experienced Payroll Administrator looking to join a friendly and supportive accountancy practice where flexibility, professional development and work-life balance are genuinely valued?

Due to continued growth, a well-established accountancy practice in Yeovil is looking to recruit a Payroll Administrator to join its busy payroll department. Working as part of a close-knit team, you'll be responsible for delivering an accurate and efficient payroll service to a diverse client portfolio while enjoying excellent support and development opportunities.

This opportunity would suit someone with previous payroll experience who enjoys building client relationships, working as part of a team and managing a varied workload in a fast-paced practice environment.

The Role

As Payroll Administrator, your responsibilities will include:
- Processing end-to-end payrolls for a portfolio of clients
- Managing weekly, fortnightly, four-weekly and monthly payrolls
- Processing starters, leavers and contractual changes
- Calculating statutory payments including SSP, SMP and SPP
- Managing pension administration and auto-enrolment duties
- Submitting RTI information to HMRC
- Handling payroll queries from clients and employees
- Maintaining accurate payroll records and ensuring compliance with payroll legislation
- Supporting colleagues within the payroll team during busy periods

About You

To be successful in this role, you'll ideally have:
- Previous payroll experience within an accountancy practice, payroll bureau or in-house payroll environment
- Knowledge of current payroll legislation and processes
- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
- Excellent organisational and time management skills
- The ability to work effectively to deadlines
- Strong communication and customer service skills
- Experience using payroll software and Microsoft Excel

What's on Offer?

In return, you'll benefit from a supportive and flexible working environment along with an excellent benefits package, including:
- Hybrid working following a successful training and onboarding period
- Flexible working arrangements that can be tailored around personal commitments, including school runs and other family responsibilities
- Full-time or part-time hours available (minimum 30 hours per week)
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- Free on-site parking
- Cycle to Work scheme
- Study support towards professional payroll qualifications, including the Level 3 CIPP qualification
- Regular staff socials and team events
- Friendly and collaborative team environment

Why Join?

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a growing and supportive accountancy practice that genuinely invests in its people. You'll become part of a small team where your contribution is recognised, whilst benefiting from flexible working arrangements, ongoing training and support towards professional payroll qualifications.

If you're looking for a role where you can continue developing your payroll career within a welcoming practice environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Please apply online ASAP, shortlisted applicants will be contacted within 48 working hours.

title: P/T Accounts Administrator/Bookkeeper
description:
P/T ACCOUNTS ADMINISTRATOR/BOOKKEEPER

Somerset Solders Ltd, incorporating Somerset Workwear, is an established and growing Somerset business supplying customers across the electronics, construction, medical and transport sectors. We are looking for an experienced and dependable Accounts Administrator to join our small, friendly team. This is a varied, hands-on role with responsibility for the day-to-day accounting administration of the business.

We are offering a permanent position working 16 hours per week with a flexible approach on how the hours are worked with hybrid working to be discussed.

Key responsibilities:
- Maintaining sales and purchase ledgers
- Credit control and customer statements
- Bank and nominal ledger reconciliations
- Resolving supplier and customer invoice queries
- Preparing and submitting VAT returns, ensuring VAT is correctly accounted for on transactions
- Liaising with colleagues, customers and suppliers on accounts matters
- Supporting month-end accounting processes / reporting to management

You'll ideally have at least two years' experience in bookkeeping or a similar accounting role and be comfortable working independently across a range of day-to-day accounting tasks. Experience with Xero is essential. Previous experience in working with an ERP system will be an advantage.

We offer:
- Permanent part-time position - 16 hours per week
- Flexible working hours to be discussed
- Opportunity for some hybrid working once established in the role
- Salary based on experience
- Company pension
- Free on-site parking
- Friendly, supportive small-team environment
- Training on the company ERP system
- Holiday entitlement increases with length of service
- We close between Christmas and New Year, usually around a week
- 20% staff discount off our products

title: TPA Liability Claims Handler
description:
TPA Liability Claims Handler

Location: Remote
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience

We are currently recruiting for an experienced Liability Claims Handler to join a well-established Loss Adjuster managing a portfolio of Employers' Liability and Public Liability claims on behalf of a range of insurer and corporate clients.
This is an excellent opportunity for a claims professional looking to join a supportive and technically focused environment, with genuine opportunities for career development.
The RoleYou will be responsible for managing liability claims from first notification through to settlement, ensuring claims are handled efficiently, fairly and in line with client requirements, regulatory standards and internal procedures.
Key responsibilities will include:
- Managing a caseload of Employers' Liability and Public Liability claims.
- Reviewing and assessing liability, quantum and coverage.
- Establishing the circumstances surrounding claims and identifying potential fraud or third-party involvement.
- Instructing and liaising with solicitors, loss adjusters, investigators and other external suppliers where appropriate.
- Negotiating settlements with claimants and their representatives.
- Making appropriate indemnity and liability decisions within delegated authority.
- Maintaining accurate claims records and ensuring files are handled in accordance with FCA and client requirements.
- Providing a high level of service to clients, brokers and other stakeholders.
- Identifying opportunities to improve claims outcomes and minimise claims leakage.
- Managing claims in line with agreed SLAs, KPIs and internal governance requirements.

About YouWe are looking for someone with previous experience handling Liability claims, ideally within a TPA, insurer, broker or loss adjusting environment.
You will ideally have:
- Experience handling Employers' Liability and/or Public Liability claims.
- A good understanding of liability principles and claims processes.
- Strong negotiation and decision-making skills.
- Excellent communication and organisational skills.
- The ability to manage a varied caseload and work to deadlines.
- A customer-focused approach with strong attention to detail.
- Experience working within delegated authority and agreed claims protocols.

CII qualifications or a willingness to work towards them would be advantageous, but relevant claims experience is the priority.
What's on Offer
- Competitive salary based on experience.
- Hybrid working.
- Structured training and professional development.
- Opportunities to progress within a growing claims operation.
- A supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Exposure to a broad and varied portfolio of liability claims.

If you are an experienced Claims Handler looking for your next opportunity within a TPA environment, we'd be keen to hear from you.

title: Receptionist / Administrator
description: We are looking for a Receptionist / Administrator to work 25.5 hours per week - for the right candiate we will also train them to work in our dispensary to cover holidays etc. This role is very varied and interesting. Processing all documents coming into the surgery, both electronically and as paper. Processing repeat prescription requests using the Practice Repeat Prescribing Protocol. Operating the internal messaging systems efficiently and completely. Meeting, greeting and checking-in patients arriving for appointments. Meeting and greeting visitors to the practice and guiding them through the practices signing-in procedure. Updating the patient computer record with administrative details of patients e.g. Change of Address Processing requests for information from Doctors, Practice Nurses and Practice Manager. Making appointments through the computer-based appointments system, using our triage system to establish and record for the clinician a brief reason for the visit / home visit. Dealing with requests and queries raised by patients visiting the practice. Answering the telephone in a timely and appropriate manner. Contacting patients by telephone as required. Various housekeeping duties including assisting with deliveries, collections and keeping the reception area tidy. Other ad hoc tasks required to support the effective and efficient day-to-day running of the practice.
